name: Bokura no Harahara School Life ~Class Zen'in Nakadashi Kanryou~
original_name: ぼくらの孕孕スクールライフ～クラス全員中出し完了～
source:
The ratio of men and women is now 1:10...

One day, the classroom teacher of Keiji's class suddenly says, "I would like you to have sex today." As a demonstration, Keiji has sex with the teacher, Ikue. And then, he has sex with his classmates...

[From ErogeShop]
